items: ✓ stop someone politely and ask the way — Could you tell me how to get to…?
✓ give a route in imperatives — Go straight on. Turn left. Cross the road.
✓ use prepositions of movement — along, past, through, across, out of, into
✓ say when to stop — Keep going until you reach the roundabout
✓ locate a building — on the left, on the corner, opposite the bank
✓ check the route back — So it’s left at the crossroads? Is that right?
